Four specs total:

- **21** — Token/Cell/Graph data structures, stream/collide tick loop, render export, performance model, 10 acceptance tests
- **22** — Rule grammar with pattern/guard/rewrite, conservation checker with @[redacted:email] annotations, compiled closures, hot-reload, archetype table, 8 acceptance tests
- **23** — Mana/Intent/Resonance as first-class tokens, coherence as derived alignment metric, spells as token spawns + rule injections + topology ops, 5 built-in spells (Fireball/FrostNova/Ward/Portal/Scry/Enchant), composition via emergent token interaction, Director/Claude/Alchemy as rule injectors, 12 acceptance tests
- **24** — What survives (renderer, MCP, telemetry, embeddings), what dies (all PDE solvers, coupling equations), concept mapping table, 3 new crates (`il_data`, `il_substrate`, `il_rules`), 6-phase 10-week roadmap, risk register

**21_SUBSTRATE_V3** — the master spec. Tokens, cells, the graph, the two-phase tick (stream + collide), archetypes (air/wood/stone/water/ice/crystal with full rule sets), spells as rule injection, performance model, derived quantities for the renderer, migration plan, acceptance criteria.

**22_RULE_GRAMMAR** — the declarative rule language. Syntax for all four rule types (local, edge, emission, transform), the expression sublanguage, the conservation checker (compile-time energy balance enforcement), the termination checker, the compilation pipeline (interpreted bytecode → optional cranelift JIT for hot rules), hot reload, priority ordering, debugging/introspection, and the player-facing spellcraft subset.

**23_GRAPH_TOPOLOGY** — the five topology primitives (AddEdge, SetPermeability, Subdivide, Coalesce, Warp), duration tracking and automatic reversal, CellId stability via epoch checking, non-Euclidean pathfinding, pocket dimensions as subgraphs, rendering implications, topology budget limits, and determinism guarantees.
